author: Eduardo Simioni
releaseNotes: 1.8.0: battery reports throttled to one every 30 s; server passwords with special characters work; hex-IP network ID when the MAC can't be found; polling of 60+ minutes works; volume 0 handled (volumeUp, mute, siren); take() and setLevel(level, duration); BREAKING: setLevel()/level now 0-100% (converted to the tablet's 0-255); speak() volume with both TTS engines; single threaded (needs hub 2.2.9+); dependent commands sent in order; Save Preferences keeps pending timers. After updating, click Save Preferences (or Configure) on each device so the new script reaches the tablet (this reloads its start page). Full list in the driver's change log.
